# LI-Init ROS 2 upstream

- Upstream: https://github.com/morte2025/LiDAR_IMU_Init_ROS2
- Integrated commit: `f8bfd9d0b02621dd411820940a012a690f4de52e`
- Algorithm origin: https://github.com/hku-mars/LiDAR_IMU_Init
- ROKA changes: Livox dependency is optional, VLP-16/EBIMU parameters are
  supplied, and the result path/automatic clean shutdown are configurable.

The upstream README declares GPLv2. The corrected ROS package manifest uses
`GPL-2.0-only`; retain the upstream README and this notice when redistributing.
